text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are trading flat with minimal daily movement, suggesting consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index has shifted sharply into greed territory over the past week, but Bitcoin's static price action indicates sentiment gains haven't translated into sustained buying pressure. At 59.2% dominance and $82B in daily volume, the market is showing moderate activity with Bitcoin anchoring positioning while altcoins like Solana pick up modest momentum.
